description: Helper functions and constants for PUCCH Format 3 and 4 in 5G NR, including DM-RS symbol masking and resource element extraction with equalization and transform precoding reversion.

methods.name: get_pucch_formats3_4_dmrs_symbol_mask
methods.description: Calculates a symbol mask indicating which symbols contain DM-RS for PUCCH formats 3 and 4 based on number of symbols, frequency hopping, and additional DMRS.

methods.name: pucch_3_4_extract_and_equalize
methods.description: Extracts resource elements from the resource grid, performs equalization, and reverts transform precoding for PUCCH Format 3/4, skipping DM-RS symbols.
